sections.title: Reflecting on your professional development
sections.content: To talk about your career trajectory, use collocations such as *tapasztalatot szerez* (to gain experience), *karriert épít* (to build a career), *szakmai fejlődés* (professional development), and *előlép* / *előléptetik* (to advance / be promoted).

sections.title: Key career verbs & nouns
rows: to move up the career ladder

items.spanish: Az elmúlt öt évben értékes szakmai tapasztalatot szereztem.
items.english: Over the past five years I have gained valuable professional experience.
After his successful work, he was promoted to department head.

items.spanish: A szakmai fejlődés és a jó csapatmunka a legfontosabb számomra.
items.english: Professional development and good teamwork are the most important for me.

sections.content: Promotion into a title takes the translative case *-vá/-vé*: *vezetővé léptették elő* (they promoted him to manager), *igazgatóvá választották* (they elected him director).
